mainEntity.name: How do I file my income tax return with FBR in Pakistan?

acceptedAnswer.text: Filing your income tax return with FBR requires an active NTN on the Iris portal at iris.fbr.gov.pk. You log in, select Income Tax Return, and enter your income, deductions, and tax paid. Kamboh Associates handles the entire process remotely — just send your salary slips or bank statement via WhatsApp and we file within 24 hours.

mainEntity.name: What documents are required for NTN registration in Pakistan?

acceptedAnswer.text: For individual NTN: CNIC, salary slip or business proof, mobile number, and email. For a business: CNIC of directors, business address proof, and SECP registration if applicable. Kamboh Associates completes NTN registration same day.

mainEntity.name: How much does SECP company registration cost in Pakistan?

acceptedAnswer.text: SECP company registration costs vary by authorized capital. For a private limited company with PKR 100,000 capital, government fees are approximately PKR 3,500-5,000. Kamboh Associates offers complete SECP registration packages starting from PKR 15,000 including NTN, STRN, and all government fees.

mainEntity.name: What is the income tax return deadline in Pakistan for 2025?

acceptedAnswer.text: The FBR income tax return deadline for individuals and AOPs is September 30, 2025 (for Tax Year 2025). For companies, the deadline is December 31. Late filing attracts penalties and removes you from the Active Taxpayer List (ATL).

mainEntity.name: Can Kamboh Associates file my tax return from any city in Pakistan?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Kamboh Associates provides fully remote, online income tax return filing for clients in Lahore, Karachi, Islamabad, Faisalabad, Rawalpindi, Multan, and all cities across Pakistan. Send documents via WhatsApp and we file directly with FBR Iris — same day acknowledgment.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between filer and non-filer in Pakistan?

acceptedAnswer.text: A tax filer in Pakistan pays significantly lower withholding tax rates. For example, non-filers pay 0.6% on bank cash withdrawals vs 0.15% for filers. On property sales over PKR 5 crore, non-filers pay 3% vs 1% for filers. Becoming a filer saves thousands of rupees annually.

mainEntity.name: Do salaried employees need to file an income tax return in Pakistan?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. All salaried employees earning more than PKR 600,000 annually (PKR 50,000/month) must file an annual income tax return with FBR. Even if your employer deducts tax, you must file personally to appear on the Active Taxpayer List (ATL) and get filer benefits.

mainEntity.name: How does a freelancer file income tax in Pakistan?

acceptedAnswer.text: Pakistani freelancers on Fiverr, Upwork, or other platforms must get an NTN, declare foreign income in their FBR tax return as business income, and file by September 30 each year. Freelancers earning through Payoneer or direct bank transfer report the PKR equivalent at the time of receipt.

mainEntity.name: How long does NTN registration take in Pakistan?

acceptedAnswer.text: Provisional NTN is generated instantly on FBR Iris. Active NTN (which gives full ATL benefits) takes 24-72 business hours after filing your first income tax return. Kamboh Associates completes the entire process same day.

mainEntity.name: Is it mandatory to have a wealth statement in Pakistan?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Any individual filing an income tax return in Pakistan must also file a Wealth Statement (Statement of Assets & Liabilities) on FBR Iris. This includes all assets: property, vehicles, bank accounts, jewelry, and investments. Failure to file or incorrect wealth statement attracts heavy FBR penalties.
